scripts.dev:web: pnpm setup:mediapipe && pnpm setup:fonts && pnpm --filter @ear-dream/app web
scripts.setup:sign-sequences: cd packages/ear-dream-api && uv run python scripts/build_sign_sequences.py
scripts.dev:api: cd packages/ear-dream-api && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.build:web-mobile: pnpm setup:mediapipe && pnpm setup:fonts && cd packages/ear-dream-app && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL= npx expo export --platform web && cd ../.. && pnpm precompress:dist
scripts.lint:api: cd packages/ear-dream-api && uv run ruff check .
